newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 4.9 bln reais in Treasury papers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 4.9 bln reais in Treasury papers.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of National Treasury, raised 4.939 billion reais during an auction Friday of two series of National Treasury Letters know as LTNs, dealers said.
A total of 3.280 billion reais of 184-day LTNs, due in September 15 1997, was sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.234 percent a month.
The Central Bank also sold 1.659 billion reais of 365-day LTNs, due in March 15 1998, at a call money rate of 2.235 percent a month.
